create_SearchExporter: create a SearchExporter instance with a Journal and config to prepare search result exports
gather_and_export_search_results: gather search data from a journal and export it to a JSON file with optional HTML tree visualization
export_search_results: export search results with timestamped filenames and log them to a CollectiveLogger with wandb HTML visualization
test_export_and_reconstruct_search_data: test that search data can be exported to JSON and reconstructed back into an equivalent Journal with preserved node relationships
run_search_exporter_main: run the search exporter test suite that validates journal export, reconstruction, and HTML tree visualization round-trip
